detectTargets-actor.label: Actor
detectTargets-actor.tip: Detect other actors near this actor's location and add them to the target pool

detectTargets-distance.label: Distance
detectTargets-distance.tip: Select actors within a circle with a specified radius

detectTargets-selector.label: Selector
detectTargets-selector.tip: Filter target actors from nearby actors

enemy.name: Enemy
enemy.tip: Select enemy actors from the target pool

friend.name: Friend
friend.tip: Select friendly actors from the target pool

team.name: Team Member
team.tip: Select team members from the target pool

team-except-self.name: Team Member Except Self
team-except-self.tip: Select team members except this actor from the target pool

any-except-self.name: Any Except Self
any-except-self.tip: Select all actors except this actor from the target pool

any.name: Any
any.tip: Select all actors from the target pool

detectTargets-inSight.label: In Sight
detectTargets-inSight.tip: Whether the target actor needs to be visible

true.name: Enabled
true.tip: Exclude target actors that are blocked by walls and not in sight

false.name: Disabled
false.tip: Select target actors even if they are not in sight
